_comment: Chapter 06 obstacle list -- input to map_clean.py.
Position is the top-left tile of the footprint, 1-based; Size is optional and
defaults to the model's VOX SIZE / 24, and is spelled out here only where the
painted art covers a different rectangle than the model box.
The map is a harbour: a stone quay along the top stacked with cargo crates,
and two red-roofed churches on the grass below it.
The church on the right is chapter 05's red_cathedral_2 standing again -- the
art is the same row of gabled bays, and only seven of its nine columns are on
the board, so its Size clips the cleaning back to what is on screen. The one
on the left has its entrance in the middle and a cross over it, which no
existing model has, so it is built by build_obstacles_06.py.
Each crate is drawn over three tile rows -- one of lid, two of front face --
but stands on the back two of them, so the model is 2 x 2 and the Size that
cleans the art is 2 x 3. Four of the eight overlap a neighbour by one tile;
the art stacks them that way and the models are left stacked too.
